policies.title: Privacy Policy
policies.lead: What this website and our support process collect—and how that differs from the records on your desktop.
policies.summary: KaratDesk is local-first desktop software. This marketing website does not automatically receive your store database. Hosting, downloads and communications still involve third-party services.

sections.title: 1. Who we are and what this covers
sections.html:
Tech Aditya provides KaratDesk and operates this product website. Our business address is Siddharth Nagar, Uttar Pradesh, India 272207. For privacy questions or requests, email 6677aditya@gmail.com.

This notice covers the website and information we handle for enquiries, licensing and support. Your use of third-party services is also subject to their own privacy notices.

sections.title: 2. Information involved in visiting or contacting us
sections.html:
• Website visits: the hosting and security infrastructure may process IP addresses, browser/device information, requested URLs, timestamps and operational logs to deliver and protect the site.
  • Enquiries and support: when you email us, we receive your email address, name if provided, message and any attachments you choose to send.
  • Paid licensing or refunds: we may request your store name, store activation ID, contact details, purchase/payment reference and the licence terms needed to issue activation or verify a transaction.

This website currently has no customer account system, payment-card checkout, advertising pixels or separate analytics scripts added by Tech Aditya. The download-agreement checkbox is held only in the current page state; it is not sent to us or stored as a server-side acceptance record.

sections.title: 3. Your local desktop records
sections.html:
KaratDesk stores business records locally, including information you enter about customers, staff, stock, invoices, purchases and payments. The store operator controls the device, user access and collection/use of those records. You are responsible for giving your own customers and staff any notices required for your business.

The website does not provide cloud synchronisation of your business database or automatically upload it to Tech Aditya. Desktop encryption keys use operating-system protection. Portable encrypted backups require a recovery passphrase. Device security, account access and tested backups remain important; encryption cannot eliminate every risk.

If you request support, share only what is necessary and redact customer information where possible. Do not email passwords, full payment-card details, database encryption keys, recovery passphrases or unredacted customer databases. Any need for access to business records must be separately discussed and limited to an agreed support purpose.

When an authorised administrator accepts the software licence in this app, the app records the accepted policy version, document fingerprint, acceptance time and accepting administrator identity in the encrypted local database. This acceptance history is included in database backups; it is not automatically uploaded to Tech Aditya.

sections.title: 4. Why we use information
sections.html:
We use information to deliver and secure the website, respond to enquiries, provide requested support, issue or verify licences, process payments/refunds, maintain necessary business records and meet applicable legal obligations. We do not sell personal information or use your local store records for advertising.

Where consent is required by applicable law, we will seek it for the specific activity. Contacting us for support is not consent to unrelated promotional messages.

sections.title: 5. Service providers, external links and cookies
sections.html:
This website is published using OpenAI Sites, with hosting/security infrastructure that may involve Cloudflare. Installer files and release pages are hosted on GitHub. Our listed support address uses Gmail. These providers may process connection, download or communication information, including outside India, according to their services and policies. We do not determine all of their infrastructure retention periods.

Our website code does not set marketing cookies or local-storage tracking identifiers. Hosting or external services may use their own essential storage, cookies or logs. Following a download or other external link takes you to that provider.

Provider information: OpenAI privacy policy, Cloudflare privacy policy, GitHub privacy statement, and Google privacy policy.

Optional online benchmark-rate features in the desktop app require a connection to a rate source. That source can receive normal connection information. Core local workflows do not require those online rates.

sections.title: 6. Retention, sharing and safeguards
sections.html:
We keep enquiry, support, licensing and transaction information only for the relevant relationship or request, reasonable record-keeping/security needs, and applicable legal/accounting requirements. The period depends on the type of record. You can ask about retention or request deletion using the email below; some records may need to be retained for legal obligations or disputes.

We limit access to information handled for these purposes and use reasonable safeguards. Information may be shared with service providers needed to fulfil a request, professional advisers, or authorities where lawfully required—not for unrelated advertising. No website, email system or device can be promised completely secure.

sections.title: 7. Requests, children and changes
sections.html:
Subject to applicable law, you may request information about our handling of your data, correction or deletion, withdraw consent where relevant, or raise a privacy complaint. Email 6677aditya@gmail.com with the subject “KaratDesk privacy request”. We may reasonably verify identity before acting. Withdrawal does not undo earlier lawful processing or eliminate legal retention obligations.

The product and website are intended for adult business users, not directed at children. If you believe a child has provided personal information to us, please contact us.

We may update this notice when our actual practices change. The version date will change, and we will provide any further notice or consent required by applicable law. A policy update does not itself authorise an unrelated new use of previously collected information.

KaratDesk assists with operational records; it is not tax, legal, investment or accounting advice. Verify invoice details, GST treatment, rates, reports and statutory compliance with qualified advisers as appropriate. Cash flow is not profit, and market benchmarks are not guaranteed selling or buying prices.

Protect your devices and user accounts, control staff permissions, keep current portable backups off the original device and test recovery. Keep recovery passphrases separately. We cannot promise recovery where all usable backups, keys or passphrases are unavailable. These responsibilities do not excuse defects or other obligations that law places on Tech Aditya.

policies.title: Trial & Refund Policy
policies.kicker: TRY IT PROPERLY. BUY WITH CLARITY.
policies.lead: A 14-day trial for new stores, plus a 7-day refund window on your first paid software licence.
policies.summary: This policy applies to new orders made on or after 30 October 2026. It adds voluntary refund rights without limiting rights or remedies available under applicable law.

sections.title: 1. The 14-day trial
sections.html:
A newly configured store may use the full-feature trial for 14 days, subject to the version’s trial controls. Downloading the trial through this website does not require payment-card details and does not automatically charge you or create an automatic paid renewal.

Use the trial to check compatibility and important workflows. Before a paid purchase, confirm your required features, support, price/taxes, licence duration and invoice/store/device allowances with Tech Aditya in writing.

sections.title: 2. First paid licence: 7-day refund window
sections.html:
If KaratDesk does not meet your needs, email a refund request within 7 calendar days after your first paid software-licence purchase. We offer a full refund of the amount paid for that covered licence, after verifying the transaction and purchaser. You do not have to prove a software defect to use this initial window.

A brief reason can help improve the product but is optional. We may offer troubleshooting, but accepting it is not a condition of a valid refund request made within the window. Requests sent in time remain in time even if verification is completed later.

sections.title: 3. Activation problems, duplicate payments and later requests
sections.html:
If you paid twice for the same order, or a promised activation cannot be supplied, contact us so we can correct the issue or refund the affected payment. These cases are not dismissed simply because the initial seven days have passed.

After the voluntary first-purchase window, we review other requests individually, including material defects, services not supplied or a product that does not match agreed features. Any remedy required by applicable law remains available. A change of mind after the window is not automatically refundable.

sections.title: 4. Renewals, upgrades and separate services
sections.html:
The voluntary seven-day offer is for the first paid software licence, not automatically each renewal, additional licence or upgrade. Any separate refund/cancellation terms must be clearly agreed before payment, and statutory rights remain unaffected.

Custom development, migration, training or installation work must have its own written scope, price and cancellation terms before work begins. The software-licence refund does not silently change those separate terms. We will not use an undisclosed “service fee” to reduce an otherwise full licence refund.

sections.title: 5. How to request a refund
sections.html:
Email 6677aditya@gmail.com with the subject “KaratDesk refund request”. Include your name/business, purchase date, payment or invoice reference, and store activation ID if available. If you cannot locate a reference, contact us for help identifying the purchase.

Do not send banking passwords, OTPs, full card credentials, encryption keys, customer databases or recovery passphrases. We may request proportionate transaction verification; we will not ask you to disclose secrets to obtain a refund.

sections.title: 6. Processing and payment method
sections.html:
We aim to acknowledge requests within 48 hours. Once eligibility and the transaction are verified, we will initiate an approved refund within 5 business days, normally to the original payment method. If that method cannot be used, we will agree a lawful alternative with you.

Your bank or payment provider may take additional time to credit the funds. Business days exclude weekends and applicable public holidays in India. We will provide an update if verification or a provider issue causes a delay; legally required timelines still apply.

sections.title: 7. Licence and records after a refund
sections.html:
After a refund, your right to use the refunded paid entitlement ends and you must stop using it. Keep your own business records and portable backups. A refund does not transfer ownership of those records to us, and we do not remotely erase your local database as a condition.

Before uninstalling, changing devices or altering a licence, use available export/backup options or ask for help preserving records. Offline licences may require administrative follow-up; do not assume a refund is a technical data-deletion or remote-revocation service.

sections.title: 8. Your legal rights and complaints
sections.html:
This policy does not exclude remedies for defective, deficient, misrepresented or undelivered products/services where applicable law provides them. It does not remove chargeback, consumer-forum or other lawful remedies. No blanket “no refunds” rule overrides mandatory rights.

For an unresolved issue, email our business/support contact at 6677aditya@gmail.com. We aim to acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and address them within one month, subject to any shorter legal requirement. See the Contact & Support page for our address.
